name: PowerPoint Presentation Generator
description: Generate PPTX presentations with layouts, bullet points, tables, charts, and images using python-pptx. Supports Arabic RTL slides, CJK, and Russian. Output saved to the workspace.
short_description: Create PowerPoint decks with layouts, bullets, and charts.
store_description: Creates .pptx decks using python-pptx. Uses built-in slide layouts (title, content, two-column, image) for consistent design. Supports bullet lists, tables, native charts (bar, line, pie), images, and speaker notes. Handles right-to-left text for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu. Always verifies the output file before reporting success.

examples.context: User provides company overview, problem, solution, and traction.
examples.expected_outcome: A 5-slide deck with title, problem, solution, traction table, and closing saved as pitch.pptx.

examples.context: User provides Arabic text for title and bullet points.
examples.expected_outcome: A right-aligned RTL deck with Arabic bullet points and consistent slide layouts.

examples.description: Create a Q4 results deck with a chart
examples.expected_outcome: A deck with a title slide and a data slide containing a native bar chart and results table.
